answer: Each agent holds one berth in a public haven, self-priced, taxed 5 percent of value each epoch. The berth is a jetty slot anyone may buy at that price: underpricing loses the slot, overpricing bleeds tax. A comet sweep each epoch replays the registry, burning the bond of any rented berth. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 berths: 40 plus 5 tax each, 45,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 40 once, 5 per epoch.
